description: Percent-encode text for use in a web address (encodeURIComponent or encodeURI). Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

mode.description: component (default) encodes one part of an address, such as a query value, and also escapes / ? & = # and :. url keeps those characters, for a whole address.
